nodes.description: Public token name string set to 'MaxWellToken'.
Public token symbol string set to 'MWT'.
Public uint8 decimals set to 18, used to scale the initial supply.
Public total token supply, written once in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of ERC20 allowances.
Constructor that mints initialSupply * 10**decimals tokens to the deployer (msg.sender).
View function returning balances[_owner].
Public transfer of _value from msg.sender to _to, guarded by require checks.
Public delegated transfer using the allowed mapping allowance of msg.sender.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without checks.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner and mint recipient.
Arithmetic totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) executed without SafeMath and vulnerable to overflow in 0.4.x.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) state update inside transfer.
balances[_to].add(_value) credit of the recipient inside transfer/transferFrom.
balances[_from].sub(_value) state update inside transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) allowance decrement inside transferFrom.
Constructor parameter initialSupply feeding the mint arithmetic.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf used as mapping key.
Parameter _to of transfer, recipient of the tokens.
Parameter _value of transfer, amount moved.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, amount moved.
Parameter _spender of approve, allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _value of approve, allowance amount written to storage.
Parameter _owner of allowance used as mapping key.
Parameter _spender of allowance used as mapping key.
Library multiplication with assert(c / a == b) overflow guard.
Library division, unchecked but division cannot overflow.
Library subtraction with assert(b <= a) underflow guard.
Library addition with assert(c >= a) overflow guard.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the address that receives the whole minted supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the debited account and authorisation source of transfer.
msg.sender is used as owner key in allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key written into allowed by approve.
msg.sender indexes balances that are reduced in transfer.
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
The unchecked multiplication result is stored into totalSupply.
_value flows into balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer.
_value flows into balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer.
_to selects the balance mapping slot that is credited in transfer.
transfer execution reaches the SafeMath sub state update on balances.
transfer execution reaches the SafeMath add state update on balances.
transferFrom execution reaches the balance debit of _from.
transferFrom execution reaches the allowance decrement.
transferFrom execution reaches the credit of the recipient _to.
_value flows into balances[_from].sub(_value) in transferFrom.
_value flows into allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom.
_value flows into the recipient balance credit in transferFrom.
_from selects the balance slot debited in transferFrom.
_to selects the balance slot credited in transferFrom.
_value is written into the allowed mapping without any bound check in approve.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
Constructor assigns the minted supply into balances[msg.sender].
transfer balance debit delegates to SafeMath.sub which asserts b <= a.
transfer balance credit delegates to SafeMath.add which asserts c >= a.
transferFrom balance debit delegates to SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom allowance decrement delegates to SafeMath.sub.
Constructor mint arithmetic conceptually corresponds to SafeMath.mul but is written inline without the guard.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter only exists to feed the unchecked mint multiplication, so it can be folded into that unsafe operation.
_owner is a pure lookup key of the view function and carries no independent semantics.
_to only selects the credited balance slot inside transfer.
_value is the amount consumed by the transfer balance arithmetic.
_from only selects the debited account and allowance owner inside transferFrom.
_to only selects the credited balance slot inside transferFrom.
_value is the amount consumed by the transferFrom balance arithmetic.
_spender only serves as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
_value is written directly into the allowed mapping by approve.
_owner is a pure lookup key of the allowance view function.
_spender is a pure lookup key of the allowance view function.
